error_page_unreadable: Eli phepha alinakufundwa. Amaphepha esikhangeli, i-Chrome Web Store kunye nee-PDF azixhaswa.
error_no_content: Akukho mbhalo wenqaku ufunyenweyo kweli phepha.

error_host_missing: Icandelo lasekhaya alifakwanga okanye aliphenduli. Kwifolda yesandiso, qhuba: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: I-Claude Code ayifumanekanga. Yifake, uze uqhube kwakhona ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_auth: Awungenanga kwi-Claude Code. Qhuba claude kwitheminali uze ungene.
error_codex_signed_out: Awungenanga kwi-Codex. Qhuba codex login kwitheminali.
error_codex_not_eligible: Isicwangciso sakho se-ChatGPT asinakusetyenziselwa oku. Khetha omnye umboneleli.

error_codex_missing: I-Codex ayifumanekanga. Yifake, uze uqhube kwakhona ./native-host/install.sh
options_help: Izishwankathelo zidlula kwicandelo lasekhaya kule khompyutha: liqhuba i-Claude Code okanye i-Codex ngobhaliso lwakho, okanye imodeli ku-Ollama. Umbhalo wephepha uthunyelwa kuphela kumboneleli omkhethayo.
error_ollama_missing: I-Ollama ayisebenzi kule khompyutha. Yifake usuka ku-ollama.com uze uyivule, uze uzame kwakhona.
error_ollama_model_missing: Le modeli ayikhutshelwanga ku-Ollama. Qhuba ollama pull negama lemodeli (umzekelo, ollama pull llama3.2), uze uzame kwakhona.
options_models_auto: Luvela kwi-Claude Code, Codex ne-Ollama, kwaye lufundwa kwakhona kanye ngosuku, xa i-Claude Code okanye i-Codex ihlaziywa, naxa isandiso sihlaziywa.
